# Overview

This script estimates the causal effects of LLM conversational interventions on election denialism beliefs and related attitudes across Studies 1 and 2. 

- **Primary Models**: Baseline-adjusted Ordinary Least Squares (OLS) models estimating treatment effects on 2020 Denialism, Claim Certainty, and secondary denialism outcomes.
- **Table Presentation**: Formatted using the [`cleanresults`](https://github.com/shayemcd/clean-results) `stargazer` style with HC1 robust standard errors and Tukey multiple-comparison adjustments for pairwise contrasts.
- **Workflow Organization**:
  - **Part I**: Primary treatment effects, contrasts, main text Figure 2 (`fig-denialism-changes.png`), standardized effect sizes, model fit comparisons, pooled models, and downstream voting likelihood.
  - **Part II**: Supplementary figures (`fig-effects.png`, `fig-effects-adjusted.png`), interface interactions, sensitivity analyses (preregistered sample, % change, ITT, full sample, speed, claim certainty cutoff), Cohen's $d$, and Lee (2009) attrition bounds.
  - **Part III**: Automated manuscript text validation and artifact generation (`results/models_effects.rds`).

```{r model administration, include=FALSE}
# Helper functions for legacy model list structures (saved in models_effects.rds)
add_stars <- function(p) ifelse(p < 0.001, "***", ifelse(p < 0.01, "**", ifelse(p < 0.05, "*", "")))

build_legacy_formula <- function(dv, dv_pre, study, interaction = FALSE) {
  fb <- paste(dv, "~", dv_pre, "+ ConditionFeedback")
  if (interaction) fb <- paste(fb, "* ConditionChat")
  if (study == 1) fb <- paste(fb, "+ ConditionChat")
  as.formula(fb)
}

fit_model_list <- function(dvs, dvs_pre, data, study, interaction = FALSE) {
  models <- purrr::map2(dvs, dvs_pre, ~ lm(build_legacy_formula(.x, .y, study, interaction), data = data))
  names(models) <- dvs
  models
}

hc1_tidy <- function(models) {
  purrr::imap(models, function(m, dv) {
    ct <- lmtest::coeftest(m, vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(m, type = "HC1"))
    tibble::tibble(term = rownames(ct), estimate = unname(ct[, 1]), std.error = unname(ct[, 2]),
                   statistic = unname(ct[, 3]), p.value = unname(ct[, 4]), outcome = dv)
  })
}

small_tab_css <- list(
  css.table = "font-size: 0.75em;",
  css.thead = "font-size: 0.75em;",
  css.depvarhead = "font-size: 0.8em;"
)
```

# PART I: PRIMARY RESULTS & FIGURES

## 1. Study 1: Primary Treatment Effects

Regresses post-intervention outcomes on conversational feedback condition (reference: Adversarial Dialogue) and interface delivery mode (reference: Chat), adjusting for centered baseline values. Pairwise contrasts among all conditions are estimated using HC1 robust standard errors and Tukey multiple-comparison adjustments.

```{r s1 primary cleanresults}
res_s1 <- clean_regress(
  df_consp,
  dvs = dvs_post,
  type = "linear",
  predictors = ~ ConditionFeedback + ConditionChat,
  baseline = baseline_map,
  contrasts = "ConditionFeedback",
  vcov_type = "HC1",
  contrast_adjust = "tukey",
  dv_labels = new_labels
)

# Regression Table (Stargazer Style)
cr_table(res_s1, style = "stargazer")
```

```{r s1 primary contrasts}
# Standalone Pairwise Contrasts Table
cr_contrast_table(res_s1, style = "stargazer")
```

Regresses post-intervention outcomes on conversational feedback condition (reference: Cats & Dogs Control), adjusting for centered baseline values with HC1 robust standard errors. ## 3. Main Text Figure: Treatment Effects Across Studies (`fig-denialism-changes`)

Figure 2: Mean pre-post change in 2020 Denialism and Claim Certainty across conditions with baseline-adjusted OLS point estimates and standard errors. Points are color-coded by condition with shapes denoting study.

```{r fig main denialism changes, fig.height=4, fig.width=8}
models_s1 <- fit_model_list(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, df_consp, study = 1)
models_s2 <- fit_model_list(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, df_consp_2, study = 2)

reg_s1 <- hc1_tidy(models_s1)
reg_s2 <- hc1_tidy(models_s2)

# % change models for secondary figure labels
build_formula_perc <- function(dv, study) {
  if (study == 1) as.formula(paste(dv, "~ ConditionFeedback + ConditionChat"))
  else as.formula(paste(dv, "~ ConditionFeedback"))
}
fit_model_list_perc <- function(dvs, data, study) {
  models <- purrr::map(dvs, function(dv) {
    dc <- data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[dv]]) & is.finite(.data[[dv]]))
    lm(build_formula_perc(dv, study), data = dc)
  })
  names(models) <- dvs
  models
}
models_perc_s1 <- fit_model_list_perc(dvs_perc, df_consp, study = 1)
models_perc_s2 <- fit_model_list_perc(dvs_perc, df_consp_2, study = 2)
regperc_s1 <- hc1_tidy(models_perc_s1)
regperc_s2 <- hc1_tidy(models_perc_s2)

fig2_outcomes     <- c("ER0Norm_Post" = "2020 Denialism", "Sureness_Post_1" = "Claim Certainty")
fig2_outcomes_pct <- c("ER0_PercChange" = "2020 Denialism", "Sureness_PercChange" = "Claim Certainty")

fig2_terms <- function(res_list, outs) {
  bind_rows(res_list) %>%
    filter(outcome %in% names(outs), startsWith(term, "ConditionFeedback")) %>%
    mutate(Outcome = unname(outs[outcome]), Condition = sub("^ConditionFeedback", "", term))
}
fig2_contrasts <- function(reg_list, regperc_list, study) {
  fig2_terms(reg_list, fig2_outcomes) %>%
    transmute(Study = as.character(study), Outcome, Condition, b = estimate, p = p.value) %>%
    left_join(fig2_terms(regperc_list, fig2_outcomes_pct) %>%
                transmute(Outcome, Condition, delta_pct = estimate, p_pct = p.value),
              by = c("Outcome", "Condition"))
}
fig2_contr <- bind_rows(fig2_contrasts(reg_s1, regperc_s1, 1), fig2_contrasts(reg_s2, regperc_s2, 2))

fmt_pct <- function(x) sub("^-", "−", sprintf("%+.1f%%", x))
fmt_b   <- function(x) sub("^-", "−", sprintf("%.1f", x))

fig2_label_stat <- "pp"
fig2_cond_colors <- c(condition_colors[c("Belief-Tailored", "Belief & Values-Tailored", "Adversarial Dialogue")],
                      Control = "#8A9BA8")
fig2_cond_order <- c("Belief-Tailored", "Belief & Values-Tailored", "Adversarial Dialogue", "Control")

fig2_pts <- df_both %>%
  filter(!is.na(ConditionFeedback)) %>%
  transmute(Study = as.character(Study), Condition = as.character(ConditionFeedback),
            `2020 Denialism` = ER0_Diff, `Claim Certainty` = Sureness_Diff) %>%
  pivot_longer(c(`2020 Denialism`, `Claim Certainty`), names_to = "Outcome", values_to = "y") %>%
  group_by(Study, Condition, Outcome) %>%
  summarise(m = mean(y, na.rm = TRUE), se = sd(y, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(sum(!is.na(y))), .groups = "drop") %>%
  left_join(fig2_contr, by = c("Study", "Condition", "Outcome")) %>%
  mutate(is_ref = is.na(b),
         Condition = factor(Condition, levels = rev(fig2_cond_order)),
         fill_key = ifelse(is_ref, "Reference condition", as.character(Condition)),
         lab = ifelse(is_ref, NA_character_,
                      paste0(if (fig2_label_stat == "pp") fmt_b(b) else fmt_pct(delta_pct), add_stars(p))))

fig2_dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.9, reverse = TRUE)

figmain <- ggplot(fig2_pts, aes(x = m, y = Condition, group = Study)) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "darkgray", alpha = .4, linewidth = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  geom_linerange(aes(xmin = m - se, xmax = m + se, color = Condition), linewidth = 1, position = fig2_dodge) +
  geom_point(aes(shape = Study, color = Condition, fill = fill_key, size = Study), stroke = 1.1, position = fig2_dodge) +
  geom_label(aes(x = m + se, label = lab, color = Condition), fontface = "bold", na.rm = TRUE,
             position = fig2_dodge, hjust = -0.1, size = 2.9, fill = "white",
             linewidth = 0, label.padding = unit(0.08, "lines"), show.legend = FALSE) +
  scale_color_manual(values = fig2_cond_colors, guide = "none") +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c(fig2_cond_colors, `Reference condition` = "white"), breaks = "Reference condition",
                    labels = "Reference condition", name = NULL) +
  scale_shape_manual(values = c(`1` = 21, `2` = 22), labels = c("Study 1", "Study 2")) +
  scale_size_manual(values = c(`1` = 4, `2` = 3.5), guide = "none") +
  guides(shape = guide_legend(order = 1, override.aes = list(fill = "grey35", color = "grey35", size = 3.5)),
         fill  = guide_legend(order = 2, override.aes = list(shape = 21, fill = "white", color = "grey35", size = 3.5))) +
  scale_y_discrete(labels = c(Control = "Cats & Dogs Control")) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(-8, 4, 2), expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.45))) +
  facet_wrap(~Outcome) +
  labs(x = "Denialism Change (pp)", y = "AI Feedback Type", title = "Conversation effects by condition",
       shape = NULL) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.title = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold"), legend.position = "top",
        plot.caption = element_text(size = 8, colour = "grey30", hjust = 0),
        plot.caption.position = "plot", legend.box = "horizontal")

figmain
ggsave("figures/fig-denialism-changes.png", figmain, width = 8, height = 5, dpi = 600, create.dir = TRUE)
```

## 5. Preregistered Model Fit Comparison ($R^2$ & BIC)

Compares explained variance ($\Delta R^2$) and model parsimony ($\Delta \text{BIC}$) when adding treatment dummy indicators over baseline-only models.

```{r model fit comparison}
df_consp   <- df_consp   %>% mutate(ConditionChatDummy = if_else(ConditionChat == "Chat", 1, 0, missing = NA))
df_consp_2 <- df_consp_2 %>% mutate(ConditionChatDummy = if_else(ConditionChat == "Chat", 1, 0, missing = NA))

build_formula_baseline <- function(dv, dv_pre) as.formula(paste(dv, "~", dv_pre))
build_formula_full_dummy <- function(dv, dv_pre, study) {
  if (study == 1) as.formula(paste(dv, "~", dv_pre, "+ ConditionDet + ConditionPers + ConditionChatDummy"))
  else as.formula(paste(dv, "~", dv_pre, "+ ConditionDet + ConditionLim"))
}

model_fit_comparison <- function(dvs, dvs_pre, data, study) {
  purrr::map2_dfr(dvs, dvs_pre, function(dv, dv_pre) {
    m_base <- lm(build_formula_baseline(dv, dv_pre), data = data)
    m_full <- lm(build_formula_full_dummy(dv, dv_pre, study), data = data)
    tibble::tibble(
      Study        = study,
      DV           = dv,
      R2_baseline  = summary(m_base)$r.squared,
      R2_full      = summary(m_full)$r.squared,
      Delta_R2     = R2_full - R2_baseline,
      BIC_baseline = BIC(m_base),
      BIC_full     = BIC(m_full),
      Delta_BIC    = BIC_full - BIC_baseline,
      p_value      = anova(m_base, m_full)$`Pr(>F)`[2]
    )
  })
}

model_fit_s1 <- model_fit_comparison(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, df_consp, study = 1)
model_fit_s2 <- model_fit_comparison(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, df_consp_2, study = 2)

model_fit_summary <- bind_rows(model_fit_s1, model_fit_s2) %>%
  mutate(DV = dplyr::recode(DV, !!!new_labels)) %>%
  mutate(across(c(R2_baseline, R2_full, Delta_R2), ~round(.x, 3))) %>%
  mutate(across(c(BIC_baseline, BIC_full, Delta_BIC), ~round(.x, 1))) %>%
  mutate(p_value = signif(p_value, 3))

model_fit_summary %>%
  kable(caption = "Preregistered Model Fit Comparison: R² and BIC With vs. Without Treatment Dummies",
        align = "l") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Times New Roman") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "responsive"),
                font_size = 12, fixed_thead = TRUE)
```

# PART II: SUPPLEMENTARY FIGURES & SENSITIVITY ANALYSES

## 8. Supplementary Figures: Multi-Outcome Treatment Effects (`fig-effects`)

Generates Figures C1 & C2: Baseline-adjusted and demographic-covariate-adjusted treatment effects across all five denialism outcomes on a 0–100 normalized scale.

```{r supplement figures, fig.height=5.5, fig.width=9.5}
supp_covs_s1 <- c('ConditionChat', 'Race', 'Age', 'GenderClean', 'Education', 'religion', 'DemRep_C.text', 
                  'EconomicConservatism', 'SocialConservatism', 'VoteMethod.text', 'AffPol_Pre', 
                  'PartyAffil.text', 'PartyReg.text', 'VoteFor2020.clean', 'Vote_1', 'Vote_Post_1', 
                  'InstTrust_USGov', 'InstTrust_CivilService', 'InstTrust_Media', 'InstTrust_Banks', 
                  'InstTrust_MajorCompanies', 'genai_trust', 'genai_fam_1', 'genai_use_1')

supp_covs_s2 <- c('Race', 'Age', 'GenderClean', 'Education', 'religion', 'DemRep_C.text', 
                  'VoteMethod.text', 'AffPol_Pre', 'PartyAffil.text', 'VoteFor2020.clean', 
                  'Vote_Post_1', 'InstTrust_USGov', 'InstTrust_Media', 'genai_trust', 'genai_fam_1', 'genai_use_1')

supp_d1 <- df_consp
supp_d2 <- df_consp_2
supp_d1$ConditionFeedback <- relevel(factor(supp_d1$ConditionFeedback), ref = 'Adversarial Dialogue')
supp_d2$ConditionFeedback <- relevel(factor(supp_d2$ConditionFeedback), ref = 'Control')

supp_outcomes_map <- list(
  '2020 Denialism'      = list(post = 'ER0Norm_Post', pre = 'ER0Norm_Pre_center'),
  'Claim Certainty'     = list(post = 'Sureness_Post_1', pre = 'Sureness_Pre_center'),
  'General Denialism'   = list(post = 'ER1Norm_Post', pre = 'ER1_Pre_center'),
  '2024 Denialism'      = list(post = 'ER2Norm_Post', pre = 'ER2_Pre_center'),
  'Composite Denialism' = list(post = 'ER_Post', pre = 'ERNorm_Pre_center')
)

fit_supp_data <- function(use_covars = FALSE) {
  res <- list()
  for (nm in names(supp_outcomes_map)) {
    om <- supp_outcomes_map[[nm]]
    f1_str <- if (use_covars) {
      paste(om$post, '~ ConditionFeedback +', om$pre, '+', paste(supp_covs_s1, collapse = ' + '))
    } else {
      paste(om$post, '~ ConditionFeedback + ConditionChat +', om$pre)
    }
    m1 <- lm(as.formula(f1_str), data = supp_d1)
    c1 <- lmtest::coeftest(m1, vcov = sandwich::vcovHC(m1, type = 'HC1'))
    for (t in c('Belief-Tailored', 'Belief & Values-Tailored')) {
      rn <- paste0('ConditionFeedback', t)
      if (rn %in% rownames(c1)) {
        res[[length(res)+1]] <- data.frame(
          Study = 'Study 1 (vs. Adversarial)', Outcome = nm, Condition = t,
          Estimate = c1[rn, 1], SE = c1[rn, 2], p = c1[rn, 4], stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
    f2_str <- if (use_covars) {
      paste(om$post, '~ ConditionFeedback +', om$pre, '+', paste(supp_covs_s2, collapse = ' + '))
    } else {
      paste(om$post, '~ ConditionFeedback +', om$pre)
    }
    m2 <- lm(as.formula(f2_str), data = supp_d2)
    c2 <- lmtest::coeftest(m2, vcov = sandwich::vcovHC(m2, type = 'HC1'))
    for (t in c('Belief-Tailored', 'Adversarial Dialogue')) {
      rn <- paste0('ConditionFeedback', t)
      if (rn %in% rownames(c2)) {
        res[[length(res)+1]] <- data.frame(
          Study = 'Study 2 (vs. Control)', Outcome = nm, Condition = t,
          Estimate = c2[rn, 1], SE = c2[rn, 2], p = c2[rn, 4], stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
      }
    }
  }
  dplyr::bind_rows(res)
}

plot_supp_effects <- function(df_data, title_text) {
  df_data <- df_data %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      Outcome = factor(Outcome, levels = rev(c('2020 Denialism', 'Claim Certainty', 'General Denialism', '2024 Denialism', 'Composite Denialism'))),
      Condition = factor(Condition, levels = c('Belief-Tailored', 'Belief & Values-Tailored', 'Adversarial Dialogue')),
      ci_lo = Estimate - 1.96 * SE,
      ci_hi = Estimate + 1.96 * SE,
      sig = dplyr::case_when(
        p < 0.001 ~ '***',
        p < 0.01  ~ '**',
        p < 0.05  ~ '*',
        p < 0.10  ~ '\u2020',
        TRUE      ~ ''
      ),
      lbl = sprintf('%.2f%s', Estimate, sig)
    )

  col_map <- c(
    'Belief-Tailored'          = '#4158A6',
    'Belief & Values-Tailored' = '#6A8E7F',
    'Adversarial Dialogue'     = '#A64521'
  )
```

## 12. Intention-to-Treat (ITT) Imputation

Conservative intention-to-treat analysis where missing post-intervention scores are replaced by carrying baseline scores forward (raw and standardized).

```{r itt models cleanresults}
add_itt_std <- function(data) {
  for (i in seq_along(dvs_post)) {
    ok <- !is.na(data[[dvs_post[i]]]) & !is.na(data[[dvs_post_std[i]]])
    map <- coef(lm(as.numeric(data[[dvs_post_std[i]]][ok]) ~ as.numeric(data[[dvs_post[i]]][ok])))
    data[[paste0(dvs_post[i], "_itt_std")]] <- map[[1]] + map[[2]] * as.numeric(data[[dvs_post_itt[i]]])
  }
  data
}
```

## 16. Cohen's d Effect Sizes

Pre-post standardized mean differences (Cohen's $d_{ppc2}$) across condition comparisons, utilizing pooled pre-treatment standard deviations and small-sample bias corrections.

```{r cohens d table}
calculate_dppc2_df <- function(data, pre_col, post_col, group_col = "ConditionFeedback") {
  d <- as.data.frame(data %>% filter(!is.na(.data[[group_col]])))
  d[[group_col]] <- droplevels(factor(d[[group_col]]))
  
  s_stats <- d %>%
    group_by(.data[[group_col]]) %>%
    summarise(
      pre_mean = mean(.data[[pre_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      pre_sd = sd(.data[[pre_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      post_mean = mean(.data[[post_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      post_sd = sd(.data[[post_col]], na.rm = TRUE),
      n = n(),
      .groups = "drop"
    ) %>% as.data.frame()
  
  T.n <- s_stats$n[2]; C.n <- s_stats$n[1]
  T.sd_pre <- s_stats$pre_sd[2]; C.sd_pre <- s_stats$pre_sd[1]
  T.m_post <- s_stats$post_mean[2]; C.m_post <- s_stats$post_mean[1]
  T.m_pre <- s_stats$pre_mean[2]; C.m_pre <- s_stats$pre_mean[1]
  
  sd.pooled <- sqrt(((T.n - 1) * (T.sd_pre^2) + (C.n - 1) * (C.sd_pre^2)) / (T.n + C.n - 2))
  yi <- metafor:::.cmicalc(T.n + C.n - 2) * ((T.m_post - T.m_pre) - (C.m_post - C.m_pre)) / sd.pooled
  
  tibble::tibble(
    `Cohen's d` = round(yi, 2),
    `Pooled SD` = round(sd.pooled, 2),
    `Pre -> Post (T)` = paste0(round(T.m_pre, 1), " -> ", round(T.m_post, 1)),
    `Pre -> Post (C)` = paste0(round(C.m_pre, 1), " -> ", round(C.m_post, 1)),
    `N (T / C)` = paste0(T.n, " / ", C.n)
  )
}
```

## 17. Attrition Robustness (Lee 2009 Bounds)

Evaluates worst-case differential attrition via Lee (2009) sharp trimming bounds. Excess participants from the higher-retention condition arm are trimmed from the upper (lower bound) and lower (upper bound) ends of the observed score distribution.

```{r lee bounds apply}
lee_bounds <- function(data, treat, outcome) {
  d <- data[!is.na(data[[treat]]), ]
  y <- d[[outcome]]
  tr <- d[[treat]]
  s1 <- mean(!is.na(y[tr == 1]))
  s0 <- mean(!is.na(y[tr == 0]))
  y1 <- y[tr == 1 & !is.na(y)]
  y0 <- y[tr == 0 & !is.na(y)]
  
  if (isTRUE(all.equal(s1, s0))) {
    diff <- mean(y1) - mean(y0)
    return(data.frame(lower = diff, upper = diff, trim_group = "None", 
                      trim_pct = 0, p_treat = s1 * 100, p_control = s0 * 100, n = nrow(d)))
  }
  
  if (s1 > s0) {
    trim_group <- "Treated"
    q <- 1 - (s0 / s1)
    cut_top <- quantile(y1, probs = 1 - q, type = 7)
    cut_bot <- quantile(y1, probs = q, type = 7)
    b1 <- mean(y1[y1 <= cut_top]) - mean(y0)
    b2 <- mean(y1[y1 >= cut_bot]) - mean(y0)
  } else {
    trim_group <- "Comparison"
    q <- 1 - (s1 / s0)
    cut_top <- quantile(y0, probs = 1 - q, type = 7)
    cut_bot <- quantile(y0, probs = q, type = 7)
    b1 <- mean(y1) - mean(y0[y0 <= cut_top])
    b2 <- mean(y1) - mean(y0[y0 >= cut_bot])
  }
  
  data.frame(
    lower = min(b1, b2), upper = max(b1, b2),
    trim_group = trim_group, trim_pct = round(q * 100, 1),
    p_treat = round(s1 * 100, 1), p_control = round(s0 * 100, 1),
    n = nrow(d)
  )
}

leebounds_dvs <- c("ER0Norm_Post", "Sureness_Post_1", "ER_Post")
leebounds_labels <- c(ER0Norm_Post = "2020 Denialism (Main)",
                      Sureness_Post_1 = "Claim Certainty",
                      ER_Post = "Election Denialism (Aggregate)")

leebounds_specs <- list(
  list(data = df_consp_limdet,    treat_level = "Belief-Tailored",             study = 1, label = "S1: Belief-Tailored vs. Adversarial"),
  list(data = df_consp_limpers,   treat_level = "Belief & Values-Tailored",    study = 1, label = "S1: Belief & Values-Tailored vs. Adversarial"),
  list(data = df_consp_detpers,   treat_level = "Belief & Values-Tailored",    study = 1, label = "S1: Belief & Values-Tailored vs. Belief-Tailored"),
  list(data = df_consp_2_limdet,  treat_level = "Belief-Tailored",             study = 2, label = "S2: Belief-Tailored vs. Adversarial"),
  list(data = df_consp_2_limctl,  treat_level = "Adversarial Dialogue",        study = 2, label = "S2: Adversarial vs. Control"),
  list(data = df_consp_2_detctl,  treat_level = "Belief-Tailored",             study = 2, label = "S2: Belief-Tailored vs. Control")
)

leebounds_summary <- purrr::map_dfr(leebounds_specs, function(spec) {
  dd <- spec$data
  dd$leebounds_treat <- as.numeric(dd$ConditionFeedback == spec$treat_level)
  purrr::map_dfr(leebounds_dvs, function(dv) {
    res <- lee_bounds(dd, treat = "leebounds_treat", outcome = dv)
    res$Study <- spec$study
    res$Comparison <- spec$label
    res$DV <- leebounds_labels[[dv]]
    res
  })
}) %>%
  dplyr::select(Study, Comparison, DV, lower, upper, trim_group, trim_pct, p_treat, p_control, n) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(across(c(lower, upper), ~ round(.x, 2)))

leebounds_summary %>%
  kable(caption = "Lee (2009) Bounds on Treatment Effects Under Differential Attrition", 
        col.names = c("Study", "Comparison", "Outcome", "Lower Bound", "Upper Bound", 
                      "Trimmed Arm", "Trim %", "Retention Treated (%)", "Retention Comp (%)", "N"),
        align = "l") %>%
  kable_classic(full_width = FALSE, html_font = "Times New Roman") %>%
  kable_styling(bootstrap_options = c("striped", "hover", "responsive"),
                font_size = 12, fixed_thead = TRUE)
```

```{r save models for supplement}
models_s1_std <- fit_model_list(dvs_post_std, dvs_precenter, df_consp, study = 1)
models_s2_std <- fit_model_list(dvs_post_std, dvs_precenter, df_consp_2, study = 2)
models_s1_int <- fit_model_list(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, df_consp, study = 1, interaction = TRUE)

models_prereg_s1 <- fit_model_list(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, df_prereg, study = 1)
models_prereg_s2 <- fit_model_list(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, df_prereg_2, study = 2)

models_s1_itt     <- fit_model_list(dvs_post_itt, dvs_precenter, df_consp_itt, study = 1)
models_s2_itt     <- fit_model_list(dvs_post_itt, dvs_precenter, df_consp_2_itt, study = 2)
models_s1_std_itt <- fit_model_list(dvs_post_itt_std, dvs_precenter, df_consp_itt, study = 1)
models_s2_std_itt <- fit_model_list(dvs_post_itt_std, dvs_precenter, df_consp_2_itt, study = 2)
names(models_s1_std_itt) <- dvs_post_std
names(models_s2_std_itt) <- dvs_post_std

models_speed_s1 <- fit_model_list(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, df_speed_s1, study = 1)
models_speed_s2 <- fit_model_list(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, df_speed_s2, study = 2)

# Re-center pre for nocc models
for (nm in names(pre_center_map)) {
  x1 <- as.numeric(df_nocc_s1[[pre_center_map[[nm]]]])
  df_nocc_s1[[nm]] <- x1 - mean(x1, na.rm = TRUE)
  x2 <- as.numeric(df_nocc_s2[[pre_center_map[[nm]]]])
  df_nocc_s2[[nm]] <- x2 - mean(x2, na.rm = TRUE)
}
models_nocc_s1 <- fit_model_list(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, df_nocc_s1, study = 1)
models_nocc_s2 <- fit_model_list(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, df_nocc_s2, study = 2)

# emmeans contrasts
analyze_outcome_robust_s1 <- function(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, data) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste(dvs_post, "~ ConditionFeedback + ConditionChat +", dvs_precenter))
  model <- lm(formula, data = data)
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(model, pairwise ~ ConditionFeedback, vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(model, type = "HC1"))
  broom::tidy(emm$contrasts, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    rename(any_of(c(adj.p.value = "p.value"))) %>%
    select(contrast, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, adj.p.value) %>%
    mutate(outcome = dvs_post)
}
analyze_outcome_robust_s2 <- function(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, data) {
  formula <- as.formula(paste(dvs_post, "~ ConditionFeedback +", dvs_precenter))
  model <- lm(formula, data = data)
  emm <- emmeans::emmeans(model, pairwise ~ ConditionFeedback, vcov. = sandwich::vcovHC(model, type = "HC1"))
  broom::tidy(emm$contrasts, conf.int = TRUE) %>%
    rename(any_of(c(adj.p.value = "p.value"))) %>%
    select(contrast, estimate, std.error, conf.low, conf.high, adj.p.value) %>%
    mutate(outcome = dvs_post)
}

emm_s1 <- purrr::map2(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, ~ analyze_outcome_robust_s1(.x, .y, df_consp)) %>%
  bind_rows() %>% mutate(Study = 1)
emm_s2 <- purrr::map2(dvs_post, dvs_precenter, ~ analyze_outcome_robust_s2(.x, .y, df_consp_2)) %>%
  bind_rows() %>% mutate(Study = 2)
emmstd_s1 <- purrr::map2(dvs_post_std, dvs_precenter, ~ analyze_outcome_robust_s1(.x, .y, df_consp)) %>%
  bind_rows() %>% mutate(Study = 1)
emmstd_s2 <- purrr::map2(dvs_post_std, dvs_precenter, ~ analyze_outcome_robust_s2(.x, .y, df_consp_2)) %>%
  bind_rows() %>% mutate(Study = 2)

m.vote <- lm(Vote_Post_1 ~ ConditionFeedback + Vote_Pre_1, data = df_vote_s2)

out_effects_list <- list(
  primary_s1     = models_s1,     primary_s2     = models_s2,
  primary_std_s1 = models_s1_std, primary_std_s2 = models_s2_std,
  interaction_s1 = models_s1_int,
  prereg_s1      = models_prereg_s1, prereg_s2 = models_prereg_s2,
  itt_s1         = models_s1_itt, itt_s2 = models_s2_itt,
  itt_std_s1     = models_s1_std_itt, itt_std_s2 = models_s2_std_itt,
  speed_s1       = models_speed_s1, speed_s2 = models_speed_s2,
  nocc_s1        = models_nocc_s1,  nocc_s2  = models_nocc_s2,
  emm            = list(s1 = emm_s1, s2 = emm_s2, std_s1 = emmstd_s1, std_s2 = emmstd_s2),
  vote           = m.vote,
  labels = list(dv = new_labels, dv_std = new_labels2, dvs_post = dvs_post, dvs_post_std = dvs_post_std, dvs_precenter = dvs_precenter),
  n_sample = list(prereg_s1 = nrow(df_prereg), prereg_s2 = nrow(df_prereg_2),
                  consp_s1 = nrow(df_consp), consp_s2 = nrow(df_consp_2),
                  speed_s1 = nrow(df_speed_s1), speed_s2 = nrow(df_speed_s2),
                  nocc_s1 = nrow(df_nocc_s1), nocc_s2 = nrow(df_nocc_s2))
)

saveRDS(out_effects_list, "results/models_effects.rds")
saveRDS(out_effects_list, "results/models_02_main.rds")

message("Successfully saved results/models_effects.rds and results/models_02_main.rds.")
```

## 20. Standalone Supplement HTML Export (OSF Archive)

Exports `results/supplement_full_regressions.html` (16 full regression tables formatted in HTML) for standalone archiving and data repository deposit (e.g., Open Science Framework). It is set to `eval=FALSE` by default so it does not clutter the knitted HTML document.

```{r supplement mega table, eval=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
supp_tab <- function(models, dv_labels, title, digits = 2) {
  tab_model(models,
            collapse.se = TRUE,
            col.order = c("est", "se", "p"),
            vcov.fun = "vcovHC", vcov.args = list(type = "HC1"),
            show.ci = FALSE, show.se = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE, p.style = "stars",
            pred.labels = supp_pred_labels, CSS = small_tab_css,
            digits = digits, dv.labels = unname(dv_labels), title = title)
}

lab_raw <- new_labels[dvs_post]
lab_std <- new_labels2[dvs_post_std]

supp_pred_labels <- c(
  "(Intercept)" = "Intercept",
  setNames(paste0("Baseline ", sub(" \\(Main\\)", "", lab_raw), " (centered)"), dvs_precenter),
  "ConditionFeedbackAdversarial Dialogue"     = "Adversarial Dialogue",
  "ConditionFeedbackBelief & Values-Tailored" = "Belief & Values-Tailored",
  "ConditionFeedbackBelief-Tailored"          = "Belief-Tailored",
  "ConditionChatQualtrics"                    = "Qualtrics interface (vs. chat)",
  "ConditionChatChat"                         = "Chat interface (vs. Qualtrics)",
  "ConditionFeedbackBelief & Values-Tailored:ConditionChatQualtrics" = "Belief & Values-Tailored × Qualtrics",
  "ConditionFeedbackBelief-Tailored:ConditionChatQualtrics"          = "Belief-Tailored × Qualtrics")

ref1  <- "reference: Adversarial Dialogue, chat interface"
ref1q <- "reference: Adversarial Dialogue, Qualtrics interface"
ref2  <- "reference: cats & dogs control"

mega_sections <- list(
  list(id = "interaction", head = "Condition × interface interaction (Study 1)",
       tabs = list(supp_tab(models_s1_int, lab_raw, paste0("Study 1: condition × interface interaction (", ref1, ")")))),
  list(id = "prereg", head = "Preregistered sample (no NLP-based filtering)",
       tabs = list(supp_tab(models_prereg_s1, lab_raw, paste0("Study 1: preregistered sample (", ref1q, ")")),
                   supp_tab(models_prereg_s2, lab_raw, paste0("Study 2: preregistered sample (", ref2, ")")))),
  list(id = "primary", head = "Primary analysis",
       tabs = list(supp_tab(models_s1, lab_raw, paste0("Study 1: primary analysis (", ref1, ")")),
                   supp_tab(models_s2, lab_raw, paste0("Study 2: primary analysis (", ref2, ")")))),
  list(id = "primary-std", head = "Primary analysis, standardized outcomes (z-scored)",
       tabs = list(supp_tab(models_s1_std, lab_std, paste0("Study 1: primary analysis, standardized outcomes (", ref1, ")"), digits = 3),
                   supp_tab(models_s2_std, lab_std, paste0("Study 2: primary analysis, standardized outcomes (", ref2, ")"), digits = 3))),
  list(id = "itt", head = "Intention-to-treat (missing post scores replaced with baseline)",
       tabs = list(supp_tab(models_s1_itt, lab_raw, paste0("Study 1: intention-to-treat (", ref1, ")")),
                   supp_tab(models_s2_itt, lab_raw, paste0("Study 2: intention-to-treat (", ref2, ")")))),
  list(id = "itt-std", head = "Intention-to-treat, standardized outcomes (z-scored)",
       tabs = list(supp_tab(models_s1_std_itt, lab_std, paste0("Study 1: intention-to-treat, standardized outcomes (", ref1, ")"), digits = 3),
                   supp_tab(models_s2_std_itt, lab_std, paste0("Study 2: intention-to-treat, standardized outcomes (", ref2, ")"), digits = 3))),
  list(id = "vote", head = "Likelihood of voting in the 2024 elections (Study 2)",
       tabs = list(tab_model(m.vote, collapse.se = TRUE, col.order = c("est", "se", "p"),
                             vcov.fun = "vcovHC", vcov.args = list(type = "HC1"),
                             show.ci = FALSE, show.se = TRUE, show.stat = TRUE, p.style = "stars",
                             dv.labels = "Likelihood of voting (post-intervention)",
                             pred.labels = c("(Intercept)", "Adversarial Dialogue", "Belief-Tailored", "Baseline likelihood of voting"),
                             title = paste0("Study 2: likelihood of voting in 2024 (", ref2, ")")))),
  list(id = "speed", head = "Primary analysis after the 10-minute completion-time exclusion",
       tabs = list(supp_tab(models_speed_s1, lab_raw, paste0("Study 1: primary analysis, 10-minute exclusion applied (", ref1, ")")),
                   supp_tab(models_speed_s2, lab_raw, paste0("Study 2: primary analysis, 10-minute exclusion applied (", ref2, ")")))),
  list(id = "nocc", head = "Primary analysis without the baseline Claim Certainty exclusion",
       tabs = list(supp_tab(models_nocc_s1, lab_raw, paste0("Study 1: baseline Claim Certainty < 50 retained (", ref1, ")")),
                   supp_tab(models_nocc_s2, lab_raw, paste0("Study 2: baseline Claim Certainty < 50 retained (", ref2, ")"))))
)

mega_intro <- paste0(
  "<p class=\"note\">Generated by <code>05_results_effects.Rmd</code> on ", format(Sys.Date()), ". ",
  "Every regression reported in the supplement, with all coefficients (estimate, with the HC1 robust standard error in parentheses), ",
  "exact two-sided <i>p</i>, number of observations, and <i>R</i><sup>2</sup> / adjusted <i>R</i><sup>2</sup> (from the ordinary OLS fit). ",
  "Each post-intervention outcome is regressed on its mean-centered baseline score, condition and, in Study 1, interface. ",
  "The reference levels are given in each table title; note that the preregistered-sample models for Study 1 use Qualtrics, not chat, as the reference interface. ",
  "Standardized-outcome models use the z-scored outcome (the standardized effects reported alongside the primary and intention-to-treat models in the supplement). ",
  "The pairwise estimated marginal means in the supplement are contrasts of the primary models and are not repeated here.</p>")

mega_html <- c(
  "<!DOCTYPE html>", "<html lang=\"en\"><head><meta charset=\"utf-8\">",
  "<title>Dialogues on Democracy: full regression output</title>",
  mega_sections[[1]]$tabs[[1]]$page.style,
  "<style>body{font-family:'Times New Roman',serif;margin:2em;} h1{font-size:1.5em;} h2{font-size:1.2em;margin-top:2.5em;border-bottom:1px solid #999;}
   .wrap{overflow-x:auto;margin-bottom:2em;} .note{max-width:60em;font-size:0.95em;}</style></head><body>",
  "<h1>Dialogues on Democracy: full regression output for the supplement (Appendix C)</h1>", mega_intro,
  "<ol>", vapply(mega_sections, function(s) sprintf("<li><a href=\"#%s\">%s</a></li>", s$id, s$head), ""), "</ol>",
  unlist(lapply(mega_sections, function(s)
    c(sprintf("<h2 id=\"%s\">%s</h2>", s$id, s$head),
      vapply(s$tabs, function(t) paste0("<div class=\"wrap\">", t$page.content, "</div>"), "")))),
  "</body></html>")
writeLines(mega_html, "results/supplement_full_regressions.html", useBytes = TRUE)
message("Wrote results/supplement_full_regressions.html (", sum(lengths(lapply(mega_sections, `[[`, "tabs"))), " tables)")
```
